subject: 2018 Mustang Hall of Fame Inductions
overview: The Mustang Hall of Fame Board of Directors hosted its 2018 induction ceremony to honor former student-athletes, coaches, and community contributors. Fourteen new members were inducted into the Hall of Fame alongside a special recognition presentation.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Board Acknowledgements
items.summary: Board President SPEAKER_15 opened the banquet and recognized the Hall of Fame Board of Directors, volunteers, and local press coverage.

items.title: Special Recognition Presentation to Michael J. McGlynn
items.summary: Reggie Graham presented a special recognition award to former Mayor Michael J. McGlynn for his years of support for Medford High School athletics and the Mustang Hall of Fame.

items.title: Welcoming Remarks from School and City Leaders
items.summary: Vocational Principal Chad Fallon, Headmaster Paul D'Alleva, Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent, and Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke offered brief remarks congratulating the honorees.

items.title: Hall of Fame Overview and Nomination Process
items.summary: SPEAKER_15 explained the mission of the Mustang Hall of Fame, detailed the nomination process, and reviewed the banquet schedule.

items.title: Induction of Nathan Clement
items.summary: John McAdam introduced inductee Nathan Clement, who delivered an acceptance speech thanking his family, coaches, and teammates.

items.title: Recognition of Past Inductees and Invocation
items.summary: Attending Hall of Fame alumni and current team captains were acknowledged before Coach Joe Barletta gave the invocation blessing.

items.title: Induction of Nicole Bilotto
items.summary: Sarah Sweat introduced inductee Nicole Bilotto, who accepted the honor and thanked her family and coaches.

items.title: Induction of Ben Walter
items.summary: Andrew Walter introduced his brother Ben Walter, who accepted his induction and reflected on his baseball career and community work.

items.title: Induction of Godfrey Chevalier
items.summary: Ken Krause presented the induction for Godfrey Chevalier (Class of 1906), which was accepted by his relative Phil Chevalier.

items.title: Induction of Tia Karen
items.summary: Niko Karen introduced inductee Tia Karen, who thanked her coaches and family in her acceptance speech.

items.title: Induction of Kyla Andre
items.summary: George Scarpelli introduced inductee Kyla Andre, who accepted the award and spoke about overcoming injuries during her high school career.

items.title: Induction of Konstantinos "Charly" Kastanidis
items.summary: Joe Barletta introduced inductee Konstantinos "Charly" Kastanidis, who expressed gratitude to his family, coaches, and teachers.

items.title: Induction of Steve Maher
items.summary: Dave Bocari introduced inductee Steve Maher, who delivered an acceptance speech thanking his coaches, teammates, and family.

items.title: Induction of Jack Dempsey
items.summary: Charlie Pagliarulo introduced coach Jack Dempsey, who shared stories from his tenure and accepted his Hall of Fame induction.

items.title: Induction of John Canavan
items.summary: SPEAKER_15 accepted the Hall of Fame plaque on behalf of the family of the late John Canavan (Class of 1945).

items.title: In Memoriam and Induction of Rob Faggiano
items.summary: Following a moment of silence for deceased members, Nicole Faggiano introduced her brother Rob Faggiano, who accepted his induction.

items.title: Induction of Pat McCarthy
items.summary: Paul Matatal introduced inductee Pat McCarthy, who recounted highlights from his high school athletic career and thanked his supporters.

items.title: Induction of Sam Lopilato
items.summary: Megan Richard introduced inductee Sam Lopilato, who delivered an acceptance speech thanking her family and former coaches.

items.title: Community Service Award Presentation to John Costello
items.summary: Michael Morgan presented the Community Service Award to John Costello for his work supporting the Mustang Football Booster Club.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Board President SPEAKER_15 concluded the ceremony by thanking attendees and asking the 2018 inductees to stand for recognition.
